assignedTasks.title: Mini-Thread Routing & UX Validation
assignedTasks.description:
Perform deep-dive testing on the threaded messaging flow. Requirements:
1. Verify reply-to levels (1-4) render correctly with connector lines.
2. Test 'Open threads' transition from Global Room to Mini Thread.
3. Validate navigation back button persistence and state conservation.

assignedTasks.title: Real-time Messaging Functional Tests
assignedTasks.description:
Test real-time data sync via Socket.io. Requirements:
1. Verify incoming messages appear instantly without refresh.
2. Test reaction counts updating across multiple devices.
3. Validate typing indicator accuracy.

assignedTasks.title: Accessibility & WCAG Compliance Audit
assignedTasks.description:
Audit the 'Midnight Glass' UI for accessibility. Requirements:
1. Check color contrast on dark backgrounds (Text Secondary #B2B2B2).
2. Verify keyboard navigation for navigation tabs and inputs.
3. Set up ARIA labels for icon-only buttons (More, Search, Profile).
